The '''Battle of Yag'Dhul''' was an early battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. Following the [[Battle of Foerost (Jedi Civil War)|sacking]] of [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]], new battlefronts opened up across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] because of the advancing Sith Empire. The Sith [[Battle of Roche (Jedi Civil War)|advanced]] on [[Roche asteroid field|Roche]], [[Battle of Axxila|Axxila]], and [[Battle of Allanteen]]; then, the Empire and conquered [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]]. At the highest extent of the Sith Empire, the planet remained under Imperial control as part of an isolated area of Sith space.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Yag'Dhul makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle. The Battle of Foerost and the [[Bombing of Telos IV]], however, are placed in [[3958 BBY]] by the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'',<ref name="KotORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and the ''Atlas'' lists Yag'Dhul as having followed Foerost and subsequent attacks, but preceding Telos.<ref name="EA" />
